user.title: Alexa Shopping List Sync
user.description:
Sign in to your Amazon account. Use a secondary account for testing if possible.

If you use an **authenticator app** for 2FA, paste your TOTP shared secret into the optional field — alexapy will then generate codes automatically and you'll never see an MFA prompt again. If left blank, you'll be prompted for a fresh code on each login.

mfa_app.title: Authenticator-app code
mfa_app.description:
Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

{message}

mfa_sms.title: SMS / email code
mfa_sms.description:
Amazon sent you a verification code via SMS or email. Enter it below.

{message}

claimspicker.title: Pick a 2FA delivery method
claimspicker.description:
Amazon is asking which method to use to deliver your code. Enter the option (usually a number).

{message}

authselect.title: Pick an authentication method
authselect.description:
Amazon is asking you to pick a primary authentication method. Enter the option.

{message}

captcha.title: Captcha required
captcha.description:
Amazon is asking for a captcha. Open the image URL below and type what you see.

{captcha_url}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Alexa Shopping List Sync
reauth_confirm.description: Your Amazon session expired. Enter your password to reconnect.

error.invalid_otp_secret: TOTP shared secret must be base32 (A–Z and 2–7 only). Common mistakes: pasting an otpauth:// URL or including 0/1/8/9. Leave it blank if you don't have the secret.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Amazon account is already configured.

confirm.title: Reconnect Alexa
confirm.description: Amazon invalidated your session. Click Submit to walk through the reauth flow.
